purpose.description: The user-facing purpose of this entire edit or batch, including required behavior and explicit constraints in natural language. Prefer concise English functional wording for retrieval against English component contracts; preserve UI labels and user quotes. Good: 'Switch customer information panels on the same page, keeping selection and content synchronized without route navigation'. Bad: 'Update UI', 'Add divs', 'Use Tabs'. For visual-only edits, describe the existing region and visual change. Do not invent requirements or provide code, IDs, operation mappings or reasoning.

customOnly.description: Pass true only when the user explicitly requires implementing this functionality yourself without existing registered components; otherwise pass false. For a batch, this must apply to all affected functionality. Omission means false.

description: Required for design mutations, including visual-only edits. Provide one purpose for the whole call; the editor derives affected regions from actual operations and receipts. Component suggestions are advisory; custom UI remains allowed.
